race.description: Vale Greg Matta - Make It Matta Hcp
race.comment: DOUBLE THE FUN (3) was very impressive in his first effort past a mile last start, rounding them up with ease in a CLass 1 at the midweeks. This is tougher, but he ran a strong figure there and looks set to raise the bar again. May need some luck early, but he can bring up back-to-back wins. ETERNAL ROMANCE (6) sat midfield at Northam last time out, winning by 1L over the mile. On the quick turnaround here, but rises out to 2100m where she's race well previously. Ran a new peak figure last start and she can go on with the job now. SISTER MARY (9) got the job done two back when swooping late before just missing at this track most recently. The inside draw may be a query with her racing pattern, but if she can get moving at the right time, she'll be flying late again. SWEET SURRENDER (5) has been flying late but just missed last start at Northam. Nottle rides again now and she can go one better. LUKA MAGIC (7) won't be far away on his recent form.
